suspicions.claim: The feed query no longer includes the current user's own posts because the OR condition (Post.author == self) was removed, so GET /api/feed will only return posts from followed users.
suspicions.trigger: Log in as a user (e.g., alice) with POST /api/tokens using HTTP Basic auth, save the access_token. Create a post as that user with POST /api/posts (json: {"text": "my post"}). Then GET /api/feed with Authorization: Bearer <token>. Read back the response data array and verify that the newly created post is absent (only posts from followed users appear).
